controls.description: Canonical entity contract exposes the columns required by maintenance controls.
controls.remediation: Reconcile the auditor with the approved entity schema change before trusting downstream checks.

controls.description: Canonical relationship contract exposes identity, endpoints, lifecycle, and payload columns.
controls.remediation: Reconcile the auditor with the approved relationship schema change before trusting graph checks.

controls.description: Canonical concept registry count matches the governed CCI/MLC baseline.
controls.remediation: Reconcile new, retired, split, or merged concepts through CCI/MLC and update this baseline in the same governed change.

controls.description: Typed concept graph matches the DPE-002 baseline.
controls.remediation: Reconcile the graph through DPE-002, preserve retired lineage, then update the baseline and recompute dependent projections.

controls.description: Candidate, proposed, or unresolved relationships have not leaked into the active canonical graph.
controls.remediation: Retire or quarantine the relationship until accepted evidence establishes canonical status.

controls.description: CCI projection version is the governed current version.
controls.remediation: Reconcile the CCI projection and update the maintenance baseline in the same reviewed change.

controls.description: MLC lifecycle projection version is the governed current version.
controls.remediation: Reconcile MLC lifecycle evidence and update the baseline only after the projection is verified.

controls.description: DPE priority projection version reflects the latest governed recomputation.
controls.remediation: Recompute DPE from current MLC and relationship inputs, verify the projection, then update the baseline.

controls.description: Dependency/unlock graph projection version is current.
controls.remediation: Reconcile DPE-002 canonical and candidate edges, then update the baseline after verification.

controls.description: DPE-001 graph inputs agree with the canonical graph baseline.
controls.remediation: Recompute DPE-001 from current canonical inputs; never hand-edit score outputs to make this check pass.

controls.description: Enterprise Documentation Graph projection version is the governed current version.
controls.remediation: Reconcile EDG relationship and documentation projections in the same governed change before updating this baseline.

controls.description: MLC module and concept baselines remain internally consistent after the governed ThreadKeeper C4 promotion.
controls.remediation: Reconcile lifecycle evidence before changing canonical maturity. C4 Operational does not imply production activation.

controls.description: ThreadKeeper is C4 Operational after TK-007, with adjacent authority boundaries preserved and production activation still false.
controls.remediation: Reconcile ThreadKeeper through TK-001/TK-002/TK-005/TK-006/TK-007, CCI, MLC, DPE, EDG, and canonical Development Evidence. Never infer production activation from C4 Operational.

controls.description: Every structured relationship resolves its required entity endpoints and optional evidence reference.
controls.remediation: Repair or retire the broken relationship through a governed evidence-preserving change.

controls.description: Every structured artifact row resolves to its owning canonical entity.
controls.remediation: Restore the owning canonical entity or remove the invalid artifact row through an approved repair.

controls.description: Declared Test control-plane RLS posture has not changed silently.
controls.remediation: Determine whether the RLS change was intentional. If intentional, verify policies/access first and update this declared Test posture in the same reviewed change.

controls.description: The DPE-002 completion journal remains present and verified.
controls.remediation: Restore or reconcile the canonical milestone journal evidence before relying on DPE-002 state.

controls.description: The governed TK-005 C1 to C2 promotion journal remains present and verified.
controls.remediation: Restore or reconcile the verified TK-005 promotion journal before relying on the historical C2 acceptance evidence.

controls.description: The TK-006 bounded Test integration evidence journal remains present and verified.
controls.remediation: Restore or reconcile the verified TK-006 Test integration journal before relying on C3 integration evidence.

controls.description: The TK-006 pre-promotion reconciliation journal remains present and verified.
controls.remediation: Restore or reconcile the verified TK-006 reconciliation journal before relying on C3 promotion readiness.

controls.description: The governed TK-006 C2 to C3 promotion journal remains present and verified.
controls.remediation: Restore or reconcile the verified TK-006 promotion journal before relying on historical C3 maturity evidence.

controls.description: The governed TK-007 C3 to C4 promotion journal remains present and verified.
controls.remediation: Restore or reconcile the verified TK-007 promotion journal before relying on current C4 Operational maturity.

controls.description: Maintenance-control external best-practice research was written through to the research evidence system.
controls.remediation: Capture the research session and sources in pm_research_sessions before treating external guidance as design evidence.

impactRules.rationale: Concept identity changes affect canonical indexing, lifecycle classification, graph topology, priority scoring, and documentation relationships.
Relationship changes alter dependency topology and may change derived prioritization and documentation navigation.
Lifecycle state is evidence-gated and directly affects development planning; stale lifecycle projections can create false maturity claims.
Schema and access-control changes can invalidate audit assumptions and must be reconciled before a PASS is trustworthy.
External research must write through to the evidence system as it occurs rather than depend on later backfill.
